name: Uderns
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy village in the Zillertal with the Fügen Spa World and an ideal location for excursions throughout the valley.
beschreibung:
Overview

Uderns is situated at an elevation of 549 meters in the heart of the lower Zillertal, occupying a broad, sun-drenched basin along the Ziller River between Fügen to the north and Ried im Zillertal to the south. With roughly 1,850 inhabitants, this charming holiday village is characterized by its flat, open valley topography, superb accessibility, and an appealing blend of rural authenticity and modern recreation. Uderns functions as the sporting and cultural centerpiece of the First Holiday Region in the Zillertal: it hosts a championship 18-hole golf course, a celebrated performing arts theater festival staged in a historic timber barn, and convenient access to the scenic Zillertal cycleway as well as the nearby Spieljoch and Hochzillertal ski arenas.

History

Urnfield culture artifacts discovered in the adjacent Finsingtal valley prove that this fertile valley floor was settled in prehistoric times. Uderns was documented as early as 933 AD as 'Udarnes' in an episcopal deed, making it one of the oldest recorded communities in the entire Zillertal. Historically, while the eastern side of the Ziller River belonged to the Prince-Archbishopric of Salzburg for centuries, Uderns consistently remained under the sovereignty of the County of Tyrol. A notable local oddity was the historical court assembly (Schranne), traditionally convened inside the village tavern rather than under open skies. From the 16th century until roughly 1870, iron ore mining in the Finsingtal and local ironworks drove prosperity. In the village center stands the Parish Church of Saint Briccius: dedicated to the saint invoked against flash floods and debris flows, the church (first recorded in 1334) received its Baroque nave between 1685 and 1688. The village also gained cultural acclaim for the Steudltenn festival, presenting innovative theater inside an ancient hay barn.

Getting There

By car, Uderns is conveniently reached from the Inntal Autobahn A12 via the Wiesing/Zillertal exit, following the well-developed Zillertal Road B169 southward for just seven kilometers (roughly eight minutes). Train travelers arrive at Jenbach station and transfer to the narrow-gauge Zillertalbahn railway, which calls every half hour at Uderns station right in town. Regional VVT bus route 8330 provides additional frequent connections throughout the valley.

Tips

Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the Golfclub Zillertal-Uderns: this 65-hectare championship 18-hole course features sweeping fairways, a covered driving range, and a signature island green on the 9th hole directly fronting the clubhouse terrace. For a singular cultural evening, attend the Steudltenn Theater Festival, which showcases contemporary drama and musical productions inside a centuries-old timber barn from spring to summer. Leisure cyclists can pedal along the flat Zillertal Cycle Path flanking the river, while spa seekers are just two kilometers from the Erlebnistherme Zillertal thermal baths in neighboring Fügen.
